passwordReset.subject: Reset your {product} password
passwordReset.body: Someone (we hope you) asked to reset the password for your account. The link works once, for an hour.
passwordReset.footer: If you didn't ask, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {organization} on {product}
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to join {organization} on {product}, where they design their courses and improve them from what happens in class.
invite.teachBody: {inviter} invited you to teach {group} ({course}) with {organization}, as a guest instructor.
invite.teachNext: You’ll read the lessons your learners read and mark what happens in class: your notes help the course get better.
invite.footer: The link works once, for 7 days. If you weren’t expecting this, ignore it.
